app_fee.value: Central research degree admissions guidance lists tuition fees and funding with no general application fee for postgraduate research degrees.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Leeds.

toefl_min.value: Specific TOEFL minimums vary by faculty and school programme; applicants should confirm scores on their individual school course pages.

ielts_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement for research degrees is IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in all components.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in all components.

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to degrees completed in a recognised majority English-speaking country; degrees completed in English elsewhere do not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: a postgraduate degree from a majority English speaking country. The duration of the degree must be at least 12 months and awarded less than 2 years and 4 months from the proposed start date of the PhD

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at the University of Leeds include PhD, MPhil, and MSc by Research programmes across eight academic faculties.
